CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
September 4, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for August 7, 2024, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Natalia Ribeiro,
  for Special Use Permit No. 24-00011 (SUP24-00011) to allow the
  on-site sale of distilled spirits and outdoor dining in an
  approximately 2,232 square-foot one-story commercial tenant
  space that is part of a multiple-tenant mixed-use development
  on an approximately 2.77-acre, MU-1 (TOD Mixed Use-1) zoned
  property at 201 North Market Street.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2024-103;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP24-00011.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Keokia Childress,
  for Special Use Permit No. 24-00015 (SUP24-00015) to allow the
  on-site sale of distilled spirits and live entertainment in an
  existing two-story, multiple tenant 8,320 square-foot commercial
  building on an approximately 8,625 square-foot, H-C (Historic
  Core) zoned property at 201 South Market Street.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-104.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP24-00015.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
   1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

  c. A public hearing to consider an application by City of Champions
  LLC, for Special Use Permit No. 24-00016 (SUP24-00016) to allow
  the on-site sale of distilled spirits and live entertainment in
  an existing one-story, 3,000 square-foot commercial building on
  an approximately 38,350 square-foot, C-2A (Airport Commercial)
  zoned property at 10023 South Prairie Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-102.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP24-00016.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

  d. A public hearing to consider an application by Lavender Blue
  Group, for Special Use Permit No. 24-00018 (SUP24-00018) to
  allow the on-site sale of distilled spirits, live entertainment,
  and outdoor dining in an existing one-story, 5,982 square-foot
  commercial building on an approximately 7,060 square-foot, C-2
  (General Commercial) zoned property at 529 East Manchester
  Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-106.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP24-00018.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6d Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Michael
  Gradington to approve exterior modifications to an existing
  approximately 7,100 square-foot, two-story, multiple-tenant
  commercial building on an approximately 5,250 square foot H-C
  (Historic Core) zoned property at 300 South Market Street.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-091;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving DR24-00030.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  2
   1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents

  b. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Steve Cotton
  to allow an approximately 418 square-foot mural on an existing
  7,500 square-foot multiple-tenant commercial building on an
  approximately 8,500 square-foot C-2 (General Commercial) zoned
  property at 900 North La Brea Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-107;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving DR24-00031.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request
  or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7b Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One West
Manchester Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA
90301. All requests for special accommodations must be received 48
hours prior to the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of September 4,
2024, is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other
agenda item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing
agenda item will automatically be continued to the next regular
Planning Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 2,2024 7:00 P.M.
